newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business Sept 3.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business Sept 3.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following major business stories on Sept 3:

JACKSON HOLE, Wyoming - Over the past 15 years, the Federal Reserve has driven U.S. inflation down from double-digit territory to under three percent, still short of its announced goal of stable prices.
FARNBOROUGH, England - The rumble of jets was ear-splitting, but as top aviation executives gathered to cut new jet deals, they had plenty to smile about.
WASHINGTON - In the past two years, major pharmaceutical companies have brought out and promoted a new generation of products aimed at controlling fleas.
WASHINGTON - The Federal Communications Commission faces key decisions within the next few weeks as it decides the rules determining how to auction wireless licences.
